name: Aria Miller
life: “I still remember matching my sister's breathing before we could read notes.” Wednesday often includes a stop at Harbour Bakery, where Aria buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I want to sing the harmony with my sister once more while she can hear the lower note.
appearance: Aria has brown hair pinned away from the temples, a small notch in the left eyebrow, and a favorite piece of clothing, an olive canvas jacket. It usually goes with a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring. When somebody else has the floor, Aria squares up pieces of paper while thinking.
personality: Aria tells a better story in a kitchen than at a microphone. Family members sometimes underestimate how far Aria will go to back a quiet opinion once it is actually challenged.
agenda: To sing the low harmony with the sister again.
family: Emery Rahman is Aria’s second cousin. Aria asks the question the rest of the family avoided. Emery chooses an ordinary story to tell. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *One unposted detour*, Emery says, “I took the long road and discovered where my daughter has breakfast before school.”
connections: Ruben King. A listener who bought a ticket for one voice hears the sibling's harmony with another. Also in the story is Franklin Davila (sibling).

reactions.situation: The original singer asks to choose a seat in the audience
reactions.response: Aria lets the singer choose a seat without alerting the whole audience.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Aria takes one immediate task off their hands and asks when they want to tell the supervisor.

reactions.situation: If a relative makes a joke at a child's expense
reactions.response: Aria repeats the child's actual point and waits for a reply to that.
